name: microservices-based-event-management-platform
description: Root workspace runner for the Event Management Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend/auth-service && npm install --prefix backend/event-service && npm install --prefix backend/registration-service && npm install --prefix backend/notification-service && npm install --prefix backend/api-gateway && npm install --prefix backend/analytics-service && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npx concurrently --names "auth,event,reg,notif,gate,analyt" --prefix-colors "blue,green,yellow,cyan,gray,white" "npm run dev --prefix backend/auth-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend/event-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend/registration-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend/notification-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend/api-gateway" "npm run dev --prefix backend/analytics-service"
scripts.dev: npx concurrently --names "auth,event,reg,notif,gate,analyt,front" --prefix-colors "blue,green,yellow,cyan,gray,white,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend/auth-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend/event-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend/registration-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend/notification-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend/api-gateway" "npm run dev --prefix backend/analytics-service" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
